rule: Catalog behavior and purpose. Do not treat historical UI labels as current until manually observed, and do not convert inferred geometry/timing into measured data.

items.name: slide_to_buy
items.documented: One deliberate slide gesture initiates a buy after amount/context are configured.

items.name: dollar_presets
items.documented: Preset dollar amounts were added to accelerate buy sizing.

items.name: buy_sell_mode
items.documented: Buy and Sell share the same trade/action context.

items.name: buy_again_sell_again
items.documented: Completed-trade surfaces gained fast re-entry/repeat actions during Dec 2025-Jan 2026 iterations.

items.name: transaction_simulation_toggle
items.documented: Transaction simulation toggle can preview transactions before sending.

items.name: verified_token_badge
items.documented: Verified-token cue exists and was moved into the buy/sell header in Feb 2026.

items.name: volatility_scam_liquidity_warnings
items.documented: Fomo describes high-volatility, scam/honeypot, unlocked-liquidity and spoofing warnings.

items.name: feed_friends_scope
items.documented: Friends/following can narrow the global social Feed.

items.name: typed_economic_feed_objects
items.documented: Feed supports buys, sells, position states, theses, transfers/deposits and other economic events over time.

items.name: trade_thesis
items.documented: Users can attach reasoning to trades; thesis later became globally visible with PnL/balance context.

items.name: threaded_trade_comments
items.documented: Trade comments expanded to threaded replies and reactions and to additional economic event types.

items.name: mutual_followers
items.documented: Mutual followers were added to reveal trader-network relationships.

items.name: leaderboard_timeframes
items.documented: Leaderboard supports 24h, 7D, 30D and All-time in official guide material.

items.name: position_drilldown
items.documented: Feed trade objects can drill into all buys/sells composing a trader position and associated commentary.

items.name: dynamic_pnl_chart_overlay
items.documented: User PnL updates on the chart itself rather than requiring a separate portfolio view.

items.name: social_chart_markers
items.documented: Followed/top-trader/community buy/sell activity can be overlaid directly on TradingView charts.

items.name: notification_signal_families
items.documented: Price, Friends, Trending, Top Traders, Announcements and New Followers are independently configurable; Friends activity has deeper filtering.

items.name: price_since_entry_alert_context
items.documented: Feed/notifications can show significant price change relative to the user's first purchase.

items.name: send_with_message_image
items.documented: Transfers between Fomo users can carry a note/image; Fomo states messages are moderated.

items.name: deposit_usd_notification
items.documented: Deposit notifications were updated to display USD amount.

items.name: qr_withdraw_address
items.documented: Withdrawal can scan a QR address rather than require copy/paste.

items.name: telegram_external_link_warning
items.documented: Fomo added a warning before external Telegram links.

items.name: search_history
items.documented: Profile/user recent searches were saved as part of Dec 2025 search improvements.

items.name: win_fumble_pnl_share_cards
items.documented: Fomo publishes/mentions win, fumble and PnL cards intended for sharing outside the app.

items.name: referral_in_shared_trade_link
items.documented: Referral code was added to shared-trade links.

items.name: liquid_glass_nav_notifications
items.documented: Nov 2025 redesign introduced translucent/liquid-glass tab bar and notifications.
measure: actual blur/opacity only from legitimate capture

items.name: biometric_step_up
items.documented: Biometric security protects app access and sensitive actions such as withdrawal/key export on supported Apple devices.

items.name: balance_at_decision_point
items.documented: On-chain/available balance was moved into the trade sheet.
